title: Battle of Kōshū-Katsunuma
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kōshū-Katsunuma", at revision 1370446697, opens: "The Battle of Kōshū-Katsunuma   took place between pro-Imperial and Tokugawa shogunate forces during the Boshin War in Japan. The battle followed the Battle of Toba–Fushimi on 29 March 1868." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q715567, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1868 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
